responsibility: Declares the RTL CFG cleanup and cross-jump API used by other backend passes. It publishes the `replace_direction` enum and entry points for cross-jump sequence matching, unreachable-block and dead-jumptable deletion, the main `cleanup_cfg` driver, and simple block-shape queries such as `bb_is_just_return`, providing the public interface to the control-flow simplification machinery in `cfgcleanup.cc`.
same_name_distinction: Provides the public declarations for RTL CFG cleanup and cross-jump support, including cleanup_cfg and related query/matching APIs; unlike gcc/cfgcleanup.cc, it is only the interface layer, not the implementation of the cleanup passes.
